more.question: N5
more.good_when: A developer, or a machine translation of the page, reads each sentence one way: each sentence tells one thing, says who does it, and does so in a grammatical form. Today "KR2.1, KR1.1, KR3.1 comes first: keep a change that improves a key result only if none before it gets worse." packs the order and a rule into one sentence and doesn't say who keeps the change, and "The accounting team prints from the invoice lines they keep, and the command names any bad line and what's wrong." and "The command only calls the library, which rounds tax to the cent the same way every time." each tell two things with two different actors.
